tools.name: convert_ingredient
tools.description: Converts an amount between volume and weight for a named ingredient (cup, tbsp, tsp, fl oz, mL, L to g, oz, lb and back). Supports US, metric, imperial, US legal and Japanese cups, US, metric and Australian spoons, sticks of butter. Says which cup it used and cites the density source.

tools.name: search_ingredients
tools.description: Fuzzy search over 271 ingredients. Returns canonical names, grams per US cup and per tablespoon, and the source (USDA FDC id or King Arthur chart).

tools.name: scale_recipe
tools.description: Scales ingredient lines by a factor or from one servings count to another. Parses mixed numbers and fraction characters. Optionally gives grams for every line.

tools.name: convert_oven_temperature
tools.description: Fahrenheit, Celsius and gas mark (1/4 to 10), with a 20 C fan oven adjustment.

tools.name: calculate_dscr
tools.description: DSCR = qualifying rent / PITIA. Exact P&I or interest-only payment, tax, insurance, HOA and other housing costs, and the lender band (1.25+, 1.00-1.24, 0.75-0.99, under 0.75).

tools.name: max_loan_for_target_dscr
tools.description: Largest whole-dollar loan that keeps DSCR at or above a target. Optional purchase price and LTV cap give the minimum down payment and which limit binds.

tools.name: rent_needed_for_target_dscr
tools.description: Smallest monthly rent that reaches a target DSCR, plus the rent for 0.75, 1.00 and 1.25.

tools.name: compare_scenarios
tools.description: Up to 5 rate, down payment, term and interest-only scenarios side by side, with DSCR, band, rent minus PITIA and total interest.

tools.name: amortization_summary
tools.description: Monthly payment, number of payments, final payment, total interest, total paid and balance after N years. Supports an interest-only period first.

tools.name: get_gold_price_per_gram
tools.description: Gold price per gram, troy ounce, tola and kilogram for 24K, 22K, 21K, 18K, 14K, 10K and 9K in any currency, with the spot time stamp and FX date.

tools.name: get_metal_prices
tools.description: Spot price of gold, silver, platinum and palladium per troy ounce, gram and kilogram in any currency. A metal whose feed is down is reported, not fatal.

tools.name: calculate_jewelry_value
tools.description: Melt value of a gold item from weight, unit and karat, with an optional dealer spread percent. States that retail and buyback prices differ from melt value.

tools.name: convert_gold_units
tools.description: Exact conversion between gram, kilogram, troy ounce, pennyweight, grain, avoirdupois ounce, tola, Thai baht, Vietnamese chi and luong, Hong Kong tael, Taiwan tael and China liang, with the definition and source of each unit.

tools.name: search_lakes
tools.description: Covered lakes by name, river, operator or state, with slug, full pool and gauge.

tools.name: get_lake_level
tools.description: Current elevation, measurement time, change over 24 hours, 7 days and 30 days, feet below full pool, the operator seasonal target where one is published, percent full where the agency publishes storage, gauge id and data URL.

tools.name: get_lake_history
tools.description: Daily or weekly elevation series for up to 365 days, with first, last, low, high and mean.

tools.name: compare_lakes
tools.description: 2 to 10 lakes side by side, ranked by feet below full pool. A lake whose gauge is down is reported, not fatal.

tools.name: get_minimum_wage
tools.description: Standard hourly rate, tipped cash wage, tip credit and effective date for one state (or DC) on a date in 2026-2027. Applies the $7.25 federal floor where a state has no law or a lower rate, and says so.

tools.name: list_upcoming_increases
tools.description: Every scheduled state change from today (or a given date) through 2027-12-31, sorted by date, with old rate, new rate and change. Inflation-indexed 2027 rates not yet published are listed as `announced: false`.

tools.name: compare_states
tools.description: 2 to 10 states side by side on one date, highest first, with full-time annual pay and the gap between highest and lowest.

tools.name: annual_income_at_minimum_wage
tools.description: Gross weekly, monthly and annual pay at a state's minimum wage for your hours per week and weeks per year.

tools.name: calculate_overtime_deduction
tools.description: Deduction for qualified overtime after the $12,500 cap ($25,000 joint) and the MAGI phase-out. Takes the W-2 box 12 code TT amount, or hourly rate + overtime hours + multiplier, or total overtime pay, and keeps only the FLSA half-time premium.

tools.name: calculate_tips_deduction
tools.description: Deduction for qualified tips after the $25,000 per-return cap and the MAGI phase-out. Limits self-employed tips to net income.

tools.name: calculate_senior_deduction
tools.description: Enhanced $6,000 deduction per person age 65 or older, reduced by 6% of MAGI over $75,000 ($150,000 joint). Accepts birth dates.

tools.name: estimate_tax_savings
tools.description: Combines the three deductions and runs taxable income through the IRS bracket tables for the year to estimate federal income tax saved.

tools.name: explain_eligibility
tools.description: Who qualifies, the excluded filing status, the SSN rule, FLSA exemptions, the W-2 and 1099 boxes, Schedule 1-A lines, and the years covered.

tools.name: calculate_take_home_pay
tools.description: Net pay per period and per year from annual or per-period gross pay, pay frequency, filing status, state and tax year. Returns federal income tax, Social Security (with the wage base), Medicare plus the 0.9% Additional Medicare tax, state income tax and the method used for it. Handles pre-tax 401(k) and payroll HSA contributions.

tools.name: compare_states_take_home
tools.description: The same pay in 2 to 10 states, ranked by take-home pay, with each state's tax and method.

tools.name: salary_to_hourly
tools.description: Annual salary to hourly, weekly, biweekly, semimonthly and monthly gross pay.

tools.name: hourly_to_salary
tools.description: Hourly wage, with optional overtime hours and multiplier, to weekly, monthly and annual gross pay.

tools.name: get_federal_tax_brackets
tools.description: Exact federal brackets and standard deduction for 2025 or 2026 and a filing status, plus the Social Security wage base and Medicare thresholds.

tools.name: calculate_uk_take_home
tools.description: Net pay a year, a month and a week. Income tax by band (England, Wales and NI, or the six Scottish bands), employee Class 1 NI, student loan (Plan 1, 2, 4, 5, Postgraduate), pension by salary sacrifice or relief at source, tax codes (1257L, S1257L, K475, BR, D0, SD1, 0T, NT) and the Personal Allowance taper above £100,000.

tools.name: get_uk_tax_bands
tools.description: Official bands for a tax year and region, as taxable-income bands and as gross-salary bands. Also the allowance taper, NI thresholds and rates by category letter, and student loan thresholds.

tools.name: compare_salaries
tools.description: Up to 5 salaries side by side: net pay, effective and marginal rates, and how much of each rise you keep.

tools.name: marginal_rate_at_income
tools.description: The true marginal rate on the next pounds of pay: income tax, NI and student loan together, including the £100,000 to £125,140 taper.

tools.name: list_federal_holidays
tools.description: All holidays for a year 1971-2100. Legal date, OPM observed date, Federal Reserve closure date, and Inauguration Day flagged as DC-area only.

tools.name: is_business_day
tools.description: Says if a date is a business day on the `federal` (OPM) or `fed_banking` (Federal Reserve) calendar. Names the holiday and gives the previous and next business day.

tools.name: add_business_days
tools.description: Adds or subtracts N business days. Lists every holiday it skipped.

tools.name: count_business_days
tools.description: Counts business days between two dates. Start and end are included by default, like Excel NETWORKDAYS.

tools.name: invoice_due_date
tools.description: Due date from an issue date and net terms (Net 30 = 30 calendar days). Rolls a weekend or holiday due date with `following`, `preceding` or `modified_following`.
